page.overview:
Who is Skeleton Drone?

Skeleton Drones, also known as Zombies and Skeleton Zombies, are Alpha Team minifigures first introduced in a 2000 video game before making a physical debut in 2001.

True to their name, Skeleton Drones have white skull faces and are dressed in red and black uniforms in every variant.

In the original video game 5714 LEGO Alpha Team released in 2000, on which the theme was based, Zombies have a custom head print with hypnotized eyes and a wide toothy grin. However, some in-game images (such as large posters in Ogel's bases) and the intro cutscene of the Game Boy Color version show them with normal skeleton heads.

Guards, Troopers, and Lurchers wear uniforms that are red on the right side and black on the left side, a silver belt going across their lower torso, and a black Mini Cap. Guards and Troopers have red epaulets and gloves, but Lurchers have black gloves and no epaulets.
